claims.evidence: Import documents, shipping papers, or Japanese auction sheet not shown in the photos.
Grading report or condition test video not shown in the photos.
Donor vehicle VIN, part numbers, or removal paperwork not shown in the photos.

risks.risk: Engine does not start or run
risks.proof: Video of the engine running with smooth idle and no abnormal noises.

risks.risk: Gearbox internal gears, bearings, or seals are worn or damaged
risks.proof: Borescope video inside the gearbox or a teardown inspection report.
Photo of donor vehicle odometer or Japanese auction/export sheet.
risks.if_unproven: priced as high-mileage and unknown age

risks.risk: Unknown donor vehicle make, model, and year
risks.proof: Donor VIN, removal invoice, or part numbers matching Nissan Rogue or Altima.

risks.risk: Missing accessories such as alternator, starter, or ECU
risks.proof: Photo showing all accessories attached or an itemized inclusion list.
risks.if_unproven: priced as engine and gearbox only

risks.proof: Bench test video or compression/leak-down test results.
Written warranty or return policy from the seller.

proof_requests: Borescope or teardown inspection of the gearbox internals
Donor vehicle VIN or removal paperwork
Photo of odometer or export/auction sheet
response.reason: The witness identifies the item as a car engine and automatic gearbox, so it can be priced at its worst case; the seller's origin, grade, and fitment claims are unproven.
